lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns across the visible mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper surfaces to lower-luminance shadowed regions immediately below the ridge lines.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse and low-contrast distribution of high-luminance pixels within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, showing significantly lower intensity and definition compared to the lateral flank blobs.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance elongated pixel cluster is visible ventral to the pelvic region, separated from the main silhouette of the shark.
